listen.title: Going to the Library
lines: Hi, Lucy. Where are you going?
I'm going to the library. I want to borrow some books about animals.
How do you usually get there?
I usually walk, but today it's raining, so I'll take the bus.
It closes at six o'clock in the evening.

qs.q: How will Lucy go to the library today?

listen.title: A Birthday Present
lines: Mike, my brother's birthday is next Sunday. What should I buy for him?
He'll be ten. He loves football very much.
Then why not buy him a football shirt?
Good idea! I saw one in a shop near our school. It's eighty yuan.

qs.q: How old will her brother be?
How much is the football shirt?

listen.title: Weekend Plans
lines: Amy, do you have any plans for the weekend?

I'm going to visit my grandparents with my parents. They live in Longgang.
That sounds nice. I'll stay at home and finish my science project.

How long has she lived in Shenzhen?
What is her favourite subject?

listen.title: The School Trip

Every Thursday after school, from four to five thirty.

listen.title: Healthy Food
lines: Tom, you often eat hamburgers for lunch.

listen.title: An English Speech Contest
lines: Attention, please. Our school will hold an English speech contest next Friday afternoon in the school hall. Each speaker will have three minutes. The topic is My Dream. listen.title: My Neighbour
lines: My neighbour, Mr Wang, is a doctor at the city hospital. He is very busy and often works at night. Although he is tired, he always smiles when he meets us. qs.q: What does Mr Wang do?
When does he often work?
What was wrong with the speaker's mother last winter?
What does Mr Wang play with his son?

retell.title: Jack's New Hobby
retell.text: Jack is a middle school student. Last year he started to learn to swim, because he wanted to be healthier. At first he was afraid of water, so his coach taught him how to breathe slowly. He practised three times a week after school. Six months later, he could swim two hundred metres without stopping. Now swimming is his favourite sport, and he plans to take part in a competition next summer.

points.p: 去年开始学游泳
原因：想更健康
一开始怕水
每周练三次
半年后能游 200 米
打算明年夏天参加比赛

retell.map: Jack → 学游泳（为什么？）→ 一开始的困难 → 怎么练 → 结果 → 计划

asks.cn: 询问 Jack 的教练叫什么名字
asks.expect: What is his coach's name? / What's the name of his coach?

asks.cn: 询问 Jack 在哪里练习游泳
asks.expect: Where does he practise swimming? / Where did he practise?

retell.title: A Special Market
retell.text: Every Saturday morning, there is a special market in our community. People bring things they no longer need, such as books, toys and clothes. Instead of paying money, they exchange things with each other. Last week I gave away three storybooks and got a model plane. The market helps people save money and reduces waste. It also gives neighbours a chance to meet and talk. Many families now go there every week.

points.p: 每周六上午，社区里的市场
带不用的东西：书、玩具、衣服
不付钱，互相交换
我换到了飞机模型
省钱、减少浪费
邻居见面聊天

retell.map: 什么时间、在哪 → 带什么 → 怎么交换 → 我的经历 → 好处（两点）

asks.cn: 询问这个市场几点结束
asks.expect: What time does the market end/close? / When does it finish?

asks.cn: 询问你还想换什么东西
asks.expect: What else do you want to exchange? / What do you want to get next time?

retell.title: Helping Grandma
retell.text: Tina's grandma lives alone in an old building without a lift. Her legs are not strong, so it is hard for her to carry heavy things upstairs. Every Sunday, Tina goes shopping for her and helps her clean the kitchen. Last month, Tina also taught her grandma how to make video calls on a smartphone. Now they can see each other every evening. Grandma says she feels much happier than before.

points.p: 奶奶一个人住，楼里没电梯
腿不好，搬重东西难
每周日帮她买东西、打扫厨房
教奶奶用手机视频通话
每天晚上能见面
奶奶更开心了

retell.map: 奶奶的情况 → 困难 → Tina 每周做什么 → 上个月教了什么 → 变化

asks.cn: 询问 Tina 的奶奶多大年纪
询问 Tina 怎么去奶奶家
asks.expect: How does Tina get to her grandma's home?

retell.title: Lily's Garden
retell.text: Lily lives in a flat without a garden, but she loves plants. Two years ago, she decided to grow vegetables on her balcony. She bought some pots and seeds, and read books to learn how to take care of them. At first, many plants died because she gave them too much water. Now she grows tomatoes, peppers and lettuce, and her family often eats fresh salad. She has even started sharing her vegetables with her neighbours.

points.p: 住公寓，没有花园，但喜欢植物
两年前开始在阳台种菜
买了花盆和种子，看书学习
一开始浇水太多，很多植物死了
现在种番茄、辣椒、生菜
还和邻居分享

retell.map: Lily 的情况 → 两年前开始做什么 → 怎么学 → 一开始的问题 → 现在种了什么 → 还做了什么

asks.cn: 询问 Lily 每天花多少时间照顾植物
asks.expect: How much time does Lily spend taking care of her plants every day?

asks.cn: 询问她最喜欢种哪种蔬菜
asks.expect: Which vegetable does she like growing best?

retell.title: A Kind Act
retell.text: Last Tuesday, Mark was riding his bike home when he saw an old man fall down on the street. Many people walked past, but Mark stopped at once. He helped the man sit up and asked if he was hurt. The man said his leg hurt badly, so Mark called his daughter with the man's phone. Twenty minutes later, she arrived and took her father to hospital. The next day, she came to Mark's school to thank him.

points.p: 上周二骑车回家，看到老人摔倒
很多人走过，Mark 马上停下
扶老人坐起来，问伤到没有
用老人的手机打给他女儿
二十分钟后女儿送他去医院
第二天来学校感谢 Mark

retell.map: 什么时间、看到什么 → 别人怎么做、Mark 怎么做 → 怎么帮 → 联系谁 → 结果 → 第二天

asks.cn: 询问老人为什么会摔倒
asks.expect: Why did the old man fall down?

asks.cn: 询问 Mark 当时有没有害怕
asks.expect: Was Mark afraid at that time?

retell.title: The Reading Club
retell.text: Our class started a reading club last month. Every two weeks, we choose one book and read it at home. Then we meet on Friday afternoon to share our ideas. Each member has to say what they learned and ask one question. At the beginning, some students were too shy to speak. But our teacher encouraged us, and now everyone joins in the discussion. I have read three books so far, and my writing has improved a lot.

points.p: 上个月班里成立读书会
每两周选一本书在家读
周五下午见面分享想法
每人说学到什么、提一个问题
一开始有人害羞，老师鼓励
读了三本，写作进步很多

retell.map: 读书会什么时候成立 → 怎么选书 → 什么时候见面 → 每人要做什么 → 一开始的问题 → 我的收获

retell.title: A Trip to the Mountains
retell.text: During the National Day holiday, Amy and her parents travelled to Huangshan. They took a high-speed train and arrived in the evening. The next morning, they got up at four o'clock to watch the sunrise from the top of the mountain. It was very cold and windy, but the view was amazing. Amy took many photos of the sea of clouds and the old pine trees. Although her legs hurt after climbing for hours, she said it was her best trip ever.

points.p: 国庆假期和父母去黄山
坐高铁，晚上到
第二天四点起床看日出
又冷风又大，但景色很美
拍了云海和松树
腿疼，但是最好的一次旅行

retell.map: 什么时候、去哪里 → 怎么去 → 第二天做什么 → 天气和景色 → 拍了什么 → 感受

asks.cn: 询问他们在黄山住了几天
asks.expect: How many days did they stay in Huangshan?

asks.cn: 询问 Amy 最喜欢哪张照片
asks.expect: Which photo does Amy like best?

retell.title: Saving Pocket Money
retell.text: Ben used to spend all his pocket money on snacks and games. Last year, his mother suggested that he should save some of it. At first, Ben thought it was boring. Then he decided to save money for a new bike. He put twenty yuan into a box every week and wrote down how much he had. It took him eight months, but he finally bought the bike himself. Now he feels proud and plans his money carefully.

points.p: 以前把零花钱都花在零食和游戏上
去年妈妈建议他存钱
一开始觉得无聊
决定存钱买新自行车
每周存二十元，记下来
八个月后自己买到车，现在会计划花钱

retell.map: 以前怎么花钱 → 谁提了建议 → 一开始的想法 → 目标是什么 → 怎么存 → 结果和变化

asks.cn: 询问 Ben 的自行车花了多少钱
asks.expect: How much did Ben's bike cost?

asks.cn: 询问他接下来想存钱买什么
asks.expect: What does he want to save money for next?
